input.name: strip_ycbcr
input.strip: profile_scanner.strip_geometry + sample (4.5-20 m, 128 metric columns over +-1.0 m), uint8, rows INTER_AREA (INTER_LINEAR if <128) resized to 128, far rows first; RIGHT strip flipped left/right (mirror_right)

mapping: logits; type argmax unknown -> no inference this frame (paused like lane_prob_dip); P(dashed) = (dashed + dbl_near)/(1 - unknown) (dbl_near = ego-side line of a double marking -> dashed, dbl_far -> solid); P(yellow) = colour softmax yellow, blue shown white; yellow + dashed passed through (strip_model.StripModel.decide4). LaneStripModel 1 uses this model for both heads.

training.init: type/backbone from the previous lane_strip_v4 (sha256 0e22e71364b6); colour branch from v3
training.data: single/data-today1023b: data-human412-bluew + label_fixes.json + 10-23 drives 419/41a/41b (auto labels 9,356 rows, user-reviewed scenes 447, Road Viewer bookmarks 100) = 32,173 rows; 417 held out
training.aug: plus-rain-more-nored + synth-double 0.15 + text negatives (negsyn) 0.25; colour head trained white/yellow, blue logit padded -10000
